Bug_Title: Classes should not be compared by name
Bug_Explanation: The bug is present in the hasSellByDate method where it compares the class name of the item object to the string "Pear" to determine if the item has a sell-by date. This is an intentional bug as it is a dangerous practice to determine an object’s type based on its class name.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by passing a Fruit object to the showBug method. The method hasSellByDate inside showBug compares the class name of the object with 'Pear' which is not compliant with the rule 'Classes should not be compared by name'.
